approval_source: Explicit user sim in HNK-LINGUAS after SWHNK-C1-PROGRESS-SNAPSHOT-V58 identified this authoring batch as the sole next gate.

decisions_requested.statement: Authorize L02-STR-005 as the fifth canonical L02 structure using selected PAT-B only within the explicitly yesterday-anchored course scope.

Authorize PA AN NE VALI as the first controlled course example, with PA meaning lexical 'ontem', AN as scoped first-person referent, NE as scoped STR005 predicate negation, and VALI as an already governed L02 predicate.
Keep the pedagogical target label 'I didn't...' while documenting that the current governed HNK realization requires explicit lexical yesterday context and does not encode generic past by itself.
Do not promote PA, AN, NE, VALI, or PAT-B beyond their current authority/scope; do not create universal declarative word order, generic past morphology, or an HNK DID auxiliary.
Do not use SAROSARI in the first STR005 example; retain the OPI-006 yes/no response branch as blocked.
Keep VANI/VANUVALI unresolved and all WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN authority labels unchanged.
Authoring STR005 must not validate STR005 or any of the existing 15 SQS slots.
Supersede the deferred 15-slot validation batch with preparation of one consolidated 16-slot SQS validation gate; do not validate those slots automatically.
